categories._source: Chatlatanagulchai et al. 2026 (Agent READMEs), Table 3 and replication package labels.py

system_overview.name: System Overview
system_overview.definition: Overview of the system or its key features.

ai_integration.name: AI Integration
ai_integration.definition: Instructions on the agent's desired behaviour or role, or on integrating/interacting with other AI tools.

documentation_references.name: Documentation and References
documentation_references.definition: Points to supplementary documents, links or references for more context; documentation artifacts (e.g. JSDoc, usage examples).

architecture.name: Architecture
architecture.definition: High-level structure, organisation and design principles; project structure or key components.

implementation_details.name: Implementation Details
implementation_details.definition: How to implement parts of the code or system, including coding style and conventions and code snippets.

build_run.name: Build and Run
build_run.definition: Compiling the code; commands to build and run the system.

test.name: Testing
test.definition: Running, adding or writing tests, including test commands.

config_environment.name: Configuration and Environment
config_environment.definition: Settings, parameters and environment needed to make the system work.

deployment_operations.name: DevOps
deployment_operations.definition: Releasing software and running it in production; CI/CD.

project_management.name: Project Management
project_management.definition: Planning and organisation of the project.

development_process.name: Development Process
development_process.definition: How to use Git properly in development and how review works (branches, commits, PRs).

performance.name: Performance
performance.definition: Performance of the system and how to improve it.

maintainability.name: Maintainability
maintainability.definition: Ease of modifying, correcting or extending the system over time.

debugging.name: Debugging
debugging.definition: Error handling and ways to debug errors and problems.

agent_only.name: Agent-only
agent_only.definition: None of the unit's knowledge is stated in the README or CONTRIBUTING at the snapshot commit.

partial.name: Partially covered
partial.definition: Some of the unit's knowledge is stated, or the topic is covered but less specifically (e.g. 'run the tests' vs the exact command).

shared.name: Shared
shared.definition: All of the unit's actionable knowledge is stated in the human docs, possibly in other words.

agent_directed.name: Agent-directed (n/a)
agent_directed.definition: The unit only makes sense for an AI agent (persona, response style, tool or prompt mechanics) and carries no project knowledge a human contributor would need.

needs._source: Dagenais et al. 2010, Table 2 (project landscape features)

barriers._source: Steinmacher et al. barrier model (58 barriers), category and barrier names as reproduced in Santos et al. 2024 (arXiv:2408.15989), Table 10; only barriers that documentation can address

finding_task.name: Finding a task to start with

finding_artifacts.name: Finding the correct artifacts to fix an issue

contribution_flow.name: Newcomers don't know what is the contribution flow

process_practices.name: Lack of knowledge in project process and practices

flags.conflict: The human docs state something that contradicts this unit (e.g. a different command or rule).
flags.links_out: The human docs only point elsewhere for this topic (website, wiki, other file).
flags.unclear: Unit is hard to judge; revisit after the pilot.
